definitions.canonicalUrl: HTTP(S) URL with lower-case scheme/host, leading www removed, default port removed, repeated path slashes collapsed, non-root trailing slash removed and fragment discarded; path/query otherwise preserved.
definitions.exactDocumentationUrl: Equality between canonical Wayfinder documentation and canonical OKF documentation.
definitions.exactEndpointUrl: Equality between canonical Wayfinder endpoint and canonical OKF url.
definitions.exactStableId: Case-sensitive equality between Wayfinder services[].id and an OKF record's id, name, final route segment, concept_id filename stem or explicitly labelled authoritative_identifier. This detects collisions, not semantic equivalence.
definitions.probableSimilarity: A high-precision title similarity signal over API-like OKF record types. It is explicitly not a match; provider equivalence is not assumed because the Wayfinder organisations are fictional.

fieldToOkfMapping.rule: Retain the source-local identifier verbatim in extras. Create a collision-safe namespaced slug for name/route/concept_id. Do not use the synthetic identifier as a global or semantic identity.
Copy as a source-supplied display title and preserve its synthetic-demo status in provenance.

Map api to API Product only when the row describes a product; map an evidenced addressable endpoint to Data Access API Endpoint. platform, library and event-stream have no automatic one-to-one API-record mapping and must retain the source type pending modelling evidence.
Resolve through the department array, then only link to a real organisation after independent authority evidence. The fictional department must not be silently equated to a UK public body.
Resolve through the team array, retain the source team identifier/title, and create a team concept and relationship only if the target model and evidence support it.
Copy as source-supplied notes; do not treat performance or scope claims in the prose as verified facts.
Canonicalise and validate the HTTP(S) URL. Create a documentation resource and evidence-bearing relationship when retrievable and licensed; the captured demo links are explicitly placeholders.

Canonicalise and validate the HTTP(S) URL. Use it as the dataset id/url only for a verified endpoint; create a resource record as appropriate. Missing or demo.gov.example values cannot evidence a live API.
Preserve verbatim. The current API-record projection has no first-class service-version field.

Map each declared mechanism through a governed vocabulary; retain the complete source array because access_model and openapi_security_scheme are scalar summaries. Do not infer credentials or store secret values.

Resolve each target service and create an evidence-bearing depends-on assertion with stable assertion ID, local routes, source/target IRIs, governed predicate/kind, status, scope, authority, derivation, observation time, evidence and rights.
Model as the inverse consumes/consumed-by assertion and deduplicate against dependsOn. Preserve direction and do not manufacture reciprocity where the source is inconsistent.
Resolve a pattern concept and select an evidenced governed predicate such as implements or related to. Keep absent identifiers unresolved; do not emit dangling assertions.
Translate through an explicit lifecycle vocabulary. Treat live only as a source claim; it is not live-service verification.
Parse as an ISO date for source-record modification. Keep capture/observation time separately in provenance.observed_at.
Retain the display string and, if parsed, store an integer with an explicit monthly unit and source date. Do not treat K/M/B suffixes as exact without a documented convention.
Retain the percentage string and optionally parse a ratio, with measurement period and source evidence. Do not upgrade it to assurance.
Copy tags as source labels. Only derive governed topics through the repository's classifier and keep that derivation explicit; tags do not establish identity or authority.
